## Change

Describe the problem, scope, and result.

## Evidence

- [ ] Deterministic MVP tests pass.
- [ ] Investor site typecheck and build pass when UI code changes.
- [ ] Generated demo bundle was rebuilt and diff reviewed when core logic changes.
- [ ] No patient data, secrets, or clinical claims were introduced.
- [ ] Research or terminology changes cite an authoritative source.

## Validation boundary

State whether this changes research logic, presentation only, or infrastructure. Document any new limitation.
